notes: Static source audit only; no native feature test. The pinned Desktop component displays/revokes per-origin preview.executeJavaScript grants from app-local localStorage for Desktop plugins declaring that capability. Hermes Native's profile-scoped AgentPluginInfo is a separate Gateway plugin model and currently has no Desktop renderer-plugin inventory, capability metadata, local origin-grant persistence, or revoke surface. PAR-0269 is therefore explicitly not implemented in the native target. A faithful implementation first needs a native Desktop-plugin host and app-local permission store; do not synthesize grants for AgentPluginInfo.
